mapper.select: SELECT sg.id, #{classId} AS classId, uc.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS studentName, u.account AS studentNo, COALESCE(sg.video_score, 0) AS videoScore, COALESCE(sg.homework_score, 0) AS homeworkScore, COALESCE(sg.exam_score, 0) AS examScore, COALESCE(sg.discussion_score, 0) AS discussionScore, COALESCE(sg.total_score, 0) AS totalScore FROM user_class uc INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = uc.user_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = 3 LEFT JOIN student_grade sg ON sg.user_id = uc.user_id AND sg.class_id = uc.class_id WHERE uc.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY COALESCE(sg.total_score, 0) DESC
